name: Cat With Knife : A Pop-Punk Mix
source:
Cat With Knife blew up the charts with their pop punk hits. But that was a long time ago.

It's been a year since Celeste left the band, and a year since they've written new music. 

You're their new manager.

Get that new song, or you're fired, and the band is over forever.

No pressure!!

[From [url=https://i-choose-paradise.itch.io/cat-with-knife]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“持刀猫咪”乐队曾凭借多首流行朋克金曲横扫各大音乐榜单——但那已经是很久以前的事了。

距离塞莱斯特退队已经过去了一年，距离乐队上一首新歌问世也整整一年了。

而你，是他们新上任的经纪人。

要么催出这首新歌，要么卷铺盖走人，眼睁睁看着乐队就此彻底解散。

一点压力都没有呢！！

[摘自[url=https://i-choose-paradise.itch.io/cat-with-knife]itch.io[/url]]
